text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp had finally 
arrived. With the Sprinters Stakes fast 
approaching, the plan was always to train 
rigorously, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer. About the morning routine—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
After trying it yesterday, I felt like I 
could push a little more. Could you 
increase the load just a tiny bit?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure to take proper breaks to 
balance it out. ...Ah, and one more 
thing—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, the supplemental snack... the rice 
balls. ...Do you have two or three more?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I think I can eat now. Right now... I'll 
be fine."

"Still... Lately, she's been showing an 
incredible amount of drive."

Normally, I'd be worried that she might be 
pushing herself too hard— but this time, 
something feels different.
choice_data_list:
(How should I put it... she's so 
consistent)

text_block_list.text:
Not through the recklessness of wearing 
oneself down, but with feet firmly planted 
on the ground, taking it step by step... I 
feel like I am truly growing stronger.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
After dinner... Could you spare me just a 
little bit of your time?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: There's something I'd like to tell you.

And so, night fell. I came to the beach 
with K.S. Miracle.

Walking silently for a bit, then coming to 
a stop. And then, K.S. Miracle began to 
speak in quiet, measured tones.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"All I've been thinking about this whole 
time is how to repay you."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The very core... of my reason to run.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's how badly I want to do it, that's 
what I'm going to do— that's what I've 
thought. All this time.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because I thought that just doing that was 
already barely enough.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"By squeezing out and using up everything 
I have, I can finally, somehow, make it 
happen."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer-san.

K.S.Miracle turned back to face this way. 
—Her eyes were.

Even under the dim moonlight, it still 
looked so vivid and bright.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was able to push past the moment I 
thought was the end.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was able to walk a future that shouldn't 
have been, and compete with so, so many 
wonderful girls—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Gaining lots and lots of rivals, 
competing, having fun, drawing strength 
from them...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've started to feel that I want to become 
faster... ...And that I truly can.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to become the "fastest of our era."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is... a token of gratitude, but not 
just paying you back. It's not simply 
returning what I received.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone. I want to give this to them, 
from me."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To think that I, who once struggled to 
even stand, could claim such an 
unimaginable honor as "fastest of an era"—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A "miracle" like that. From me, to 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —To you.

K.S.Miracle smiles. A lump forms in my 
throat. Whatever this welling emotion is, 
at its core, it can only be a blessing.

How could one not celebrate this? After 
all, back then, she grieved in such 
anguish, lamenting that "I have nothing at 
all."

She used to cry out, "I have nothing to 
give." ...Yet now, she has so much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but really, the one who brings out 
the wins in me is you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In the end, all I ever do is pay you back 
for things, Trainer. ...Ahaha, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-Wah... ah, huh? ...Trainer?

Desperate to make them understand, she 
bursts into a run out of pure frustration.

Standing on the shore, paying no mind to 
the splashing waves, and then—
choice_data_list:
The "fastest of the era"! I'm gonna be 
it!!!

The "fastest of the era"! I'm gonna be 
it!!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: If we could be together! I... I just...!!
If we could be together! I... I just...!!

text_block_list.text:
If your trainee manages to grasp the crown 
she longed for, well... there is truly 
nothing quite like it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, fufu. Ahaha... Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-You startled me...! Ahahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see. That you'd... feel that way about 
me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...All right!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...I'll...! Do my veeeeryyy beeest!!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes!! Without fail! 
Absolutely!!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I will win!! Just you waaaatch!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I wonder how long it's been since I 
last raised my voice this loud.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, but... I couldn't hold back 
anymore either.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That Trainer from earlier... was kind of 
cute."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like my excitement got the better 
of me. ...Ahaha!!"
